limitations: The example documents the scope of the SPDX identifier. A work-specific grant requires the authorized notice. Exact publisher bytes and matching to a work were unverified.
reasoning: The nondeprecated root ListedLicense GFDL-1.1-no-invariants-or-later names GNU FDL v1.1 or later. Its standard header allows later FSF-published versions and explicitly excludes Invariant Sections, Front-Cover Texts and Back-Cover Texts.
